As good luck would have it, they had had a whale alongside a day or two previous, and
the great tackles were still aloft, and the massive curved blubber hook, now clean and
dry, was still attached to the end.
This was quickly lowered to Ahab, who at once comprehending it all, slid his solitary thigh
into the curve of the hook.
It was like sitting in the fluke of an anchor, or the crotch of an apple tree, and then giving
the word, held himself fast, and at the same time also helped to hoist his own weight,
by pulling hand over hand upon one of the running parts of the tackle.
Soon he was carefully swung inside the high bulwarks, and gently landed upon the capstan
head.
With his ivory arm frankly thrust forth and welcome, the other captain advanced, and Ahab
putting out his ivory leg, and crossing the ivory arm like two swordfish blades cried
out in his walrus way,
Aye aye hardy, let us shake bones together, an arm and a leg, an arm that never can shrink,
do you see, and a leg that never can run.
Where didstie thou see the white whale, how long ago?
